verdict: Oats with milk are better for weight loss. Lower calories, almost double the protein, and more filling.
why: Oats with milk are about 250 kcal, two slices of roti bakar kaya mentega (kaya butter toast) about 300 kcal.
Oats with milk have about 11 g of protein, roti bakar only about 6 g.
Roti bakar has about 13 g of fat from the butter, oats with milk about 7 g.
Kaya toast is easy to eat quickly and often comes with half-boiled eggs and sweet coffee, so the total calories go up.
when_a: Roti bakar kaya mentega is okay when you lepak at a kopitiam and want to enjoy a classic breakfast once in a while.
when_b: Oats with milk suit a daily breakfast at home or at the office, easy to prepare in 5 minutes.
tip: If you eat roti bakar, add two half-boiled eggs for protein and ask for kopi kurang manis (coffee, less sweet). If it's oats, add a banana for sweetness without sugar.

faq.q: Are instant oats okay or do I need the slow-cooking kind?
faq.a: Both are okay. The key is not adding a lot of sugar. Use fruit for sweetness.

faq.q: Kaya has a lot of sugar, should I avoid it?
faq.a: No need to avoid it. Spread it thinly, and don't make it an everyday thing if you want to lose weight.
